signals_info.description: Whether AEB is actively intervening in vehicle control.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition aeb_active == 1 shall newly become true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，aeb_active == 1 这一条件应刚开始成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: AEB shall begin intervening at some future time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: AEB 应在未来某个时刻开始介入。
